title: Akiyama Mizuki — To Be There With You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Line: Main Street
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
I worked so hard during my shift today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see, after I get home, I'm gonna watch that anime I recorded, work on N25 stuff and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mafuyu's meeting with her mom this weekend, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's so strong...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (First she had the courage to open up to her dad, and now this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's making these brave decisions, so I want to support her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I know Kanade's gonna be with her, but I'm still really worried.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, thinking about this is filling my stomach with butterflies...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I'm feeling this way, then Mafuyu and Kanade must be feeling even worse.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should buy some stomach medicine and give it to them in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Those look like...
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool, they have kits for making your own accessories.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I haven't been to this shop in so long that I didn't know they started carrying things like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, what do they have...? Necklaces and bracelets. Oh, these actually look pretty fancy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But now doesn't seem like the right time to be making these.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, wait...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because, until just recently, I thought you'd given up on everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Like when you stopped wearing that ribbon you like so much. It was as if nothing mattered to you anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Also... Here, take this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A ribbon...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes. I made it using my favorite kind of fabric. It's cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, if you ever feel like wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would I be able to encourage her the same way Sis did for me with that ribbon?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like a lucky charm that cheers you up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
I know Mafuyu doesn't believe in those kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe it'll help her feel that, even if we can't be with her in person, we'll be with her in spirit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, these could make for some nice lucky charms.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alrighty!
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There we are!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... I got four bracelet kits and a whole bunch of extra bits and decorations!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. After giving it a lot of thought, I decided to make us matching bracelets in different colors♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Matching accessories...
The old me would never have believed the words that just came out of my mouth.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The idea of wanting the same thing as someone else would've been unthinkable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This desire to want to do something for your friends...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I never realized that it'd feel so warm...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder if I can imbue these bracelets with this feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It probably isn't the same warmth Mafuyu wants. But these will let her know that we're there with her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll need to craft these really carefully.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (With all the warmth the others have given me.)
